owner() returns msg.sender instead of the stored owner.
Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(address(0)) so ownership is renounced instead of transferred to newOwner.
Replace _transferOwnership(newOwner) with _transferOwnership(msg.sender) so ownership is transferred to the caller instead of newOwner.
Delete the _transferOwnership(newOwner) call so the owner never changes.
Delete the zero-address require so transferring ownership to address(0) succeeds and sets owner to the zero address.
Remove the _checkOwner() call so any caller can pass the onlyOwner modifier, letting non-owners call transferOwnership and change the owner.
